learning_outcomes.text: Students recognize the relationships within the tool/machine/workpiece system, analyze the interaction between input variables, system parameters, and technological characteristics, and evaluate the interdependencies of individual machine tool components for design optimization with maximum economic efficiency of the overall investment.
Students can evaluate the influence of different parameters on tools and their systems.

syllabus_topics: Classification and elements of machine tools
Frames -> Structure and tasks, thermal influences, static forces, residual stresses
Dynamic behavior of machine tools -> Free vibrations, excitations in machine tools, forced vibrations, self-excited vibrations
Linear guideways -> Function – requirements – properties, design forms, plain guideways, rolling guideways, hydrostatic guideways
Main drives -> Motor and gear technology, energy storage
Feed drives -> Basic structure, position control, electrical drive technology, hydraulic drive
Numerical controls -> Structure of numerical controls, types of control, operation and programming, interpolation in movements, position measuring systems, errors in position setting
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written examination. The ungraded assessment is an experimental work, consisting of approximately 3 to 5 experimental tasks. Specifics for the written examination are according to the valid study regulations.
